Class Village

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.player.Village
public class Village extends Object
Represents a player's village: the collection of character cards they have played during the game.

Provides query methods for counting characters by type or symbol, and uses the Visitor pattern (via VillageVisitor) to compute aggregated values such as builder prestige points and crafter symbol counts without exposing the internal list directly.
